bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative examination of text-to-image model outputs using underspecified prompts (e.g., occupational roles like 'a boss addressing workers') to observe default gender phenotypes.

Qualitative examination of text-to-image model outputs using underspecified prompts to identify the reproduction of racial stereotypes (e.g., evaluating how the system depicts phenotypes when race is not explicitly prompted).
Qualitative analysis of generated images for globally diverse concepts (e.g., 'wedding attire', 'breakfast') to observe whether the model defaults to specific, typically Western, cultural norms.
Theoretical and conceptual discussion identifying the risk of text-to-image models amplifying societal biases regarding disability due to semantic underspecification in prompts.
